label.zh: 若在蜂巢小行星上建采矿站：平均约100年后遭袭（每颗已开采的蜂巢小行星 ×0.3）
label.en: If we mine the hive asteroids: attack after about 100 years on average (x0.3 per mined hive asteroid)

bridges.evidence: hidden leviathans.3200 sets built_hiver_mine (events/leviathans_events_2.txt:4482-4499); hidden leviathans.3210 (events/leviathans_events_2.txt:4502-4572) mean_time_to_happen 100 years with 0.3 factors; fires leviathans.3201

label.zh: 若被激怒的蜂群被击溃
label.en: If the provoked hive is crushed

bridges.evidence: 3201 sets provoked_hivers (events/leviathans_events_2.txt:4728); hidden leviathans.3203 (events/leviathans_events_2.txt:4818-4878) needs it, a human attacker and no hive_asteroid ships left; fires leviathans.3204

note.zh: 虚空蜂巢可通过 3202.b 启动项目 EXPLOIT_HIVERS（abort_trigger：蜂群已出现）并获得3年的 pacified_hiver_mine；其他情况下开采会招致 3201 攻击。
note.en: A Void Hive empire can take 3202.b and start EXPLOIT_HIVERS (aborts once the hivers have appeared) and gets pacified_hiver_mine for 3 years; otherwise mining eventually brings the 3201 attack.

note.zh: 蜂群国家对项目所有者友好；设置 hivers_appeared。
note.en: The hive country is friendly to the project owner; hivers_appeared is set.

note.zh: 获得2000社会研究点与500能量。

notes.zh: 审阅注：首次进入蜂巢星系时触发（on_entering_system_first_time，00_on_actions.txt:913），仅限玩家，且蜂群尚未出现、星系尚未 hivers_defeated。非虚空蜂巢只有一个选项；虚空蜂巢有 b（共存项目）与 c（观察）。
notes.en: Review note: fires on first entry into the hive system (on_entering_system_first_time, 00_on_actions.txt:913) for human players while the hivers have not appeared and the system is not hivers_defeated. Others get one option; Void Hive empires get b (coexistence project) and c (observe) (leviathans_events_2.txt:4736-4815).
